correctness.rationale: The multiplication law gives [g(a,b,c),g(a′,b′,c′)]=(0,0,ab′+a′b), so the center and derived subgroup are exactly the central-coordinate copy of the additive field. In characteristic two, g(a,b,c)^2=(0,0,ab); all central coordinates occur as squares, so the Frattini subgroup equals the same center. The equation ab=0 has exactly 2q-1 ordered solutions, yielding exactly 2q^2-q-1 involutions and q(q-1)^2 order-four elements. The displayed psi formula follows by an exact partition of all q^3 elements. The packaged replay independently verifies all counts for q=2,4,8,16.

value.rationale: The primary literature explicitly identifies formulas for nonabelian special 2-groups as an open problem. UT_3(F_{2^m}) is a canonical finite Heisenberg family and, for m>=2, crosses the exact structural boundary left untreated by the extraspecial calculations. The result is uniform for every field extension degree, gives the complete element-order distribution rather than one numerical value, and adds the normalized asymptotic limit 4. This is a motivated structural slice of the open problem, not an arbitrary small-case computation.
